method: MMseqs2 easy-cluster, whole predicted proteomes, no gene-list filtering; cluster representative membership is provisional family proxy

train.R: Oviedo group T. rubra MAKER2, 9324, SHA256 38558c6debceb107be62ac2f23a153225e4f3cf435f54946e3f764121a90534c

holdout.O: Oviedo group independent T. dohrnii MAKER2 17469, SHA256 6bfe8ae8ac13ada336730cc98f740b81e3d0080facb41a0bee361530ee3a8ae1

ranking: main-vs-rubra family size ratio corrected by proteome sizes (M/23314)/(R/9324), only families with M>=3 and R>=1; freeze top20 before holdout. Main-only clusters are catalogued but not given infinite-ratio discovery credit. Family membership must be checked for isoforms and intact distinct loci before any expansion claim.
null: Benjamini-Hochberg across all tested families on one-sided Fisher exact tests of main vs rubra membership counts and remaining proteomes, exploratory due annotation imbalance; no biological PASS without independent structural/holdout support.
limits: Different gene predictors and protein completeness (23314 main vs 9324 rubra) can mimic expansion. MMseqs clusters are similarity groups, not guaranteed orthogroups. Biological lifespan groups are not independent n>1.
